correctness.rationale: Every bracket coefficient on edge (v,w) equals det((a_v,b_v),(a_w,b_w)), including characteristic two with alternating bracket. Nonzero-root tree extension realizes arbitrary incident edge data with nonzero descendant vectors. On the unique cycle, zero/two/at-least-three nonzero edge coefficients admit nonzero vectors throughout via explicit base triangle and subdivision; exactly one nonzero edge forces a zero at a cycle vertex off the active edge. If an unbranched vertex exists there, zero can be located without blocking attached-edge data; otherwise prescribing a nonzero attached coefficient at every branched vertex gives contradiction. Deleting one cycle edge leaves a spanning tree and a second bracket supplies its residual. Thus width 1 iff each edge e has U\V(e) nonempty; else exactly 2 for all fields. Independent F2 brute force verified triangle, triangle-with-leaf, square-with-leaf, square-with-adjacent-leaves bracket images and two-bracket sums; this is corroboration, not the infinite proof.
